question: _______ of the Constitution deals with the amendment procedure of the Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 368**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 368**

 
 
• **Amending India's Constitution** involves altering the** fundamental or ultimate law of the country**.
 
• **Part XX (Article 368) of the Indian Constitution **specifies the process for** amending the constitution**.
 
• This process **protects the Constitution of India's sanctity and restrains the Parliament of India's arbitrary power**.
 
• The** 24th and 42nd Amendments, passed in 1971 and 1976**, respectively, amended **Article 368**.
 
• As stated in **Part-xx Article 368 (1) of the Indian Constitution**, Parliament may alter the Constitution by **adding to, changing, or repealing any provision in accordance with the procedure specified therein**, which is distinct from the procedure for ordinary modifications.
 
• According to the process **outlined in article 368 for amending the Constitution, a change can only be made by introducing a Bill in one of the two Houses of Parliament**.
